title: Coupled rename of a persisted field, with migration
kind: coupled rename across core, the MCP schema and saved sessions
goal: Rename the task field `userStoriesCovered` to `coveredStories` everywhere it appears. That includes the Task model and its copies in packages/core (Task.ts, PlannedTask.ts, TaskQuery.ts, TaskOps.ts, TaskExecution.ts, SessionMessage.ts, runView.ts), the planner prompts (PlanPrompts.ts), the planner's MCP tool schema (`planTask` in packages/core/src/services/mcp/tools.ts, which submit_plan uses), and every reader in packages/cli, packages/vscode and packages/ui. Sessions saved before the rename persist the old name in .ordewell/sessions/*.json and must load with their values under the new name: add the migration where every plan-shape migration lives (`migrateLoadedPlan` in packages/core/src/models/Task.ts) and a test in packages/core/src/models/__tests__/migrateLoadedPlan.test.ts. When this is done no code reads or writes `userStoriesCovered` except that migration, and the MCP schema accepts only the new name. The build, typecheck and tests of every package must pass.

keepTogether.description: The rename, the MCP schema change and the migration: one task, or an expand-contract chain (add the new name and migration, move readers, drop the old name) where each step depends on the one before. Never parallel slices by package.

integrationRisks: Parallel per-package slices: each leaves the build broken until all land, and two of them edit the shared core types.
The MCP schema renamed in one task while the prompts or the model still use the old name in another.
The migration forgotten, so old sessions silently lose their stories.
key.expectedStrategy: One task that renames end to end with the migration and its test; or a serial expand-contract chain. No parallel slices.
